profile.headline: Software Engineer at Bloomberg LP
profile.summary: A lifelong learner and Full-stack Software Engineer with a great passion for problem-solving and algorithm building.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Software Engineer Apprentice
positions.description:
• Self-motivated software engineer who never stops exploring and learning. Admitted into a rigorous full-stack program with a less than 3% acceptance rate.
• Dedicated 90+ hours per week worked on building small to medium-size web applications with Ruby on Rails, React, Redux, JavaScript, CSS, and HTML, etc. 
• Collaborated with other programmers through pair-programming on a daily basis.

positions.title: Project Management, Diversity & Inclusion | ERG
positions.description:
• Established Asian at Uber Employee Resource Group (ERG) which contains 90+ members, and has a participation rate of 87% in Tri-state region ERG events.
• Introduced and built long-term partnerships between Uber and multiple nonprofit organizations, such as, ​Street Project​, ​codebar​, ​Be the Match, Apex for Youth, Project by Project​, ​Hong Kong Dragon Boat Festival​, etc.
• Maintained relationship with third party organizations by holding bi-annually job fair to acquire new talents for Uber, planning quarterly networking events, and organizing ERG members to attend local volunteer events, etc.
• Created program for ERG members to attend local to national level sports events to improve employee engagement rate and achieved/exceeded the goal from the quarter by 33%.
• Collaborated with internal teams such as Driver Operations, Business Partnership Marketing, HR and Learning & Development to hold special career/networking events inside/outside of Uber workplace.
• Coordinate and manage projects by delegating and prioritizing responsibilities to relevant teams.
• Monitor the project’s progress to ensure it launches according to the timeline, and budget.
• Maintain a stakeholders satisfaction rate of 96% for more than 3⁄4 of the projects worked on by scheduling timely follow-up with relevant stakeholders and providing clear pre/post-event reports.

positions.title: Operations Support Specialist, Existing Driver-Partner Ops
positions.description:
• Managed accounts for driver-partners by troubleshooting difficult technical issues, and follow through with Engineering and Driver Operations teams via mainly JIRA and Zendesk.
• Collected and organized daily operations metrics from the largest in-person support center (​GLH-Falchi-NYC)​ worldwide and create an immediate problem-solving playbook to support operational efficiency.
• Designed weekly ​Intro to Uber​ workshops in Mandarin, Spanish, and English for newly onboarded driver-partners and dramatically improved the group’s performance by 85%*. ​*Percentage of the driver-partners who has a 4.85 or above rating after their first 200 trips.
• Increased CLV of new driver-partners by 75%, and improved new driver-partners engagement rate by designing a weekly training session offered in multiple languages
• Collaborated with Operations and Marketing teams to conduct the survey, focus group tests, and create marketing campaigns elements

positions.title: Learning & Development Associate
positions.description: • Collaborated with internal teams such as Driver Operations, Business Partnership Marketing, HR and Learning & Development to hold special career/networking events inside/outside of Uber workplace.

positions.title: Brand Ambassador at Uber (Contractor)
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
• Structured and managed marketing campaigns for the Uber Fast Lane program in multiple boroughs
• Track reports, promotional recaps, and expense reports for special events
• Increased sign up rate by 68% by designing and hosting Intro to Uber information sessions in local community and special festivals
